register.labelZh: FACE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: face off 可以描述兩支隊伍、兩名選手或兩名候選人直接較量。；face onto 可以說明房間、窗戶或建築物朝向哪個地方。；face somebody down 表示某人拒絕被嚇倒,並使對方退讓。；face up to 可以表示不再逃避,並承認問題、錯誤、真相或責任。
register.summaryEn: Face off lets you describe two teams, players or candidates competing directly against each other. Face onto helps you explain what a room, window or building looks towards. Face somebody down shows that a person refuses to be frightened and causes the other person to give way. Face up to helps you talk about accepting a problem, mistake, truth or responsibility instead of avoiding it.

contextsEn: Describe the direction of rooms and windows
Describe courage during a difficult confrontation
Talk honestly about difficult facts and duties

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In a FACE... DOWN expression, place the person between FACE and DOWN: face him down face them down Face off is complete by itself. To name the opponent, you may add against: face off against another team
